newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco seizes three tonnes of cocaine on a beach.
newsitem.headline: Morocco seizes three tonnes of cocaine on a beach.

text.p: Morocco has seized three tonnes of cocaine which washed up on a Casablanca beach, the interior ministry said on Friday.
"Police have discovered three tonnes of pure cocaine after it washed up on a Casablanca shore in plastic bags," a statement carried by the official news agency MAP said.
It said the drug, which was discovered early this week, was packed in watertight bags. Local and international police were working jointly to determine its origin, it said.

"If we take into account that the cocaine street value stands at between $50 and $100 per gram...the total seized quantities on the Casablanca coastline would be at between $150 and $300 million," said an official at the interior ministry.
"It is the first time such huge quantities were seized in Morocco since a nationwide campaign against drug smuggling was launched in January 1996," he added.
Daily l'Opinion said on Wednesday children playing on that beach had found the first bags.
